unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U16: Use corporate-veil and comparison analysis without blanket exemptions

payload.title: Separate personality is the starting point, not a licence for misuse
payload.core_explanation_md:
The corporate veil can be examined in the described exceptional situations, such as misuse of the form for fraud. Establish the applicable legal basis and facts; a disappointed creditor cannot simply label a company a sham and automatically recover from every member. Conversely, incorporation does not erase liability for a person own wrongful conduct or a separate guarantee.

Compare an ordinary firm and a company through the actual legal form, agency, property and continuity rules. Avoid broad claims that a company has no legal protections because it is not a citizen, or that every company must have identical limited liability. The entity documents and applicable law govern the particular question.

self_check.prompt_text: Does veil-lifting automatically follow any unpaid company debt?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. It requires the relevant legal ground and facts.

payload.stem_md: A recovery proposal demands payment from every shareholder solely because the company defaulted. No guarantee or veil-lifting ground is identified. What is missing?

options.explanation_md: That is not a liability basis.

options.text_md: A rule that all defaults automatically establish fraud
options.explanation_md: Default alone does not establish fraud.

options.text_md: Proof that all members are directors
options.explanation_md: Even that label would not settle every liability.

options.text_md: An applicable basis for personal liability beyond mere shareholding
options.explanation_md: Separate personality is the starting point.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Separate personality is the starting point.

payload.stem_md: A director argues incorporation automatically removes their separately executed personal guarantee. Which analysis is appropriate?

options.text_md: Accept the argument because every personal obligation ends
options.explanation_md: Incorporation does not have that effect.

options.text_md: Examine the guarantee as a separate obligation
options.explanation_md: Company personality does not erase an independent undertaking.

options.text_md: Treat every shareholder as the guarantor
Ignore both the company debt and guarantee

payload.correct_explanation_md: Company personality does not erase an independent undertaking.
